title: TaskSignal
description: One open task, personal or work, in the single shape Michael's task intelligence reads (CLAUDE.md §10.5). Built by src/lib/task-signal.ts from Task or WorkTask; read by services/intelligence/app/tasks. Carries no user, organization, task or goal id: `ref` is a request-local handle the server maps back.

status.description: Open statuses only; a finished task is never signalled.

priority.description: The user's own priority. LifestyleOS has no 'urgent'.

dueDate.description: Calendar date, already in the owner's (or organization's) clock.

remainingMinutes.description: User-confirmed work left; null when not recorded.

actualEffort.description: Planned is not actual (CLAUDE.md §8): no actual-effort data exists, and the signal says so rather than inventing it.

dependencies.description: Direct dependency state; null where the product has no dependencies (LifestyleOS).

goals.description: Active goals the user linked this task to (LifestyleOS). Empty when none.

project.description: The work task's active project; null when it has none or for personal tasks.

postponements.description: Times the due date was moved later; null when the history is not recorded (WorkOS keeps no due-date values in its activity log).
